item.title: Tropical Storm Karina strengthens into a hurricane in the Pacific
item.description: Forecasters say it could become a major storm this week.

item.title: International manhunt for alleged diamond thieves: Police
item.description: Two men allegedly stole a 200-carat diamond necklace once owned by Egyptian royalty from a Vienna museum.

item.title: Ross Fire burns 85,000 acres, leaves destruction across 2 counties
item.description: The Ross wildfire has burned over 80,000 acres in Palo Pinto and Jack counties, causing evacuations, road closures, and school disruptions.

item.title: Google updates maps to show 'Lake America' in U.S. after Trump order
item.description: Google began rolling out changes to how it displays Lake Ontario's name after President Trump signed an executive order.
